result_text:
I added `DataStore.listOverduePurchaseOrdersBySupplier(long supplierId, LocalDate date)` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, right after the warehouse version. `OpenPurchaseOrdersTest` passes with the new test.

It returns the supplier's orders with status `SENT` and an expected date strictly before the given date. They come earliest expected date first, ties by id, each with its order lines. Orders expected on the date itself, and draft, received or cancelled orders, are left out. It copies the SQL and line-loading code of the existing overdue methods.

The new test is `listsOverdueOrdersOfOneSupplier` in `OpenPurchaseOrdersTest.java`. It covers your 13 July example, the exact-date boundary, another supplier and an unknown supplier id.

I didn't add a service-layer method or a `DemoScenario` call, since the existing overdue lookups are used straight from `DataStore`.
